material_type.evidence: About 1g plant material was harvested in triplicate for each genotype and treatment, ground using liquid nitrogen and immediately dissolved in 2 volumes of extraction buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 10 mM EDTA, 10% glycerol A2696 PanReac, 0.5% IGEPAL CA-630 I8896 Sigma, 0.5 mM DTT, 1 protease inhibitor Roche tablet/50 mL buffer, 1 g PVPP/ 50 mL buffer, 1 PhosSTOP tablet/ 10 mL buffer) by vortexing.

strain.evidence: Plants expressing 35S:SAP18-GFP(Col0), 35S:SAP18-GFP(sr45) and 35S:GFP(Col0) were grown for 10 days in MS media under a 16:8 photoperiod at 22 °C.
